name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It guarantees visibility on monochrome and low-contrast backgrounds, which matters most for keyboard users who rely on focus indicators. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it’s worth it for universal usability.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast still fails on high-DPI mobile screens where 4px collapses to 2px—making it invisible to users who need it most. A 3px ring at 5.5:1 contrast keeps visibility on mobile while meeting WCAG for low-vision users. Settle it with real device testing: if the 3px ring is visible at 200% zoom on a 4K phone, it’s the safer choice.
